<b>Quick Sling</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It doubles the number of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} that are thrown with one input.

== Usefulness ==
Allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to throw two {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} at a time instead of one. 

The additional thrown Tool is not free; two Tool charges will be consumed. The projectile maximum capacity is <i>not</i> doubled; the quantity per throw is. 

For example, if the maximum capacity of [[Straight Pin|Straight Pins]] is 24, the supply will be exhausted in 12 throws.

Quick Sling does not affect [[Silkshot]], [[Delver's Drill]], [[Rosary Cannon]], [[Flintslate]], [[Snare Setter]], [[Flea Brew]], or [[Plasmium Phial]].{{MissingInfo}}.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in a hidden room above a breakable ceiling in [[Bilewater]].
